Welcome to the Friday Night Guitar Thread!

Objectives: To have ourselves a good time, sharing music that we created. The emphasis is on music we created.

We're not picky. It doesn't have to be guitar, nor does it have to be particularly good. Any and all instruments, including vocals, are welcome.

How to contribute: If you're really new, I'd suggest watching for an hour or two, listening, and then maybe starting to share some of you work.

For best results, don't share a lot of tracks at one time, or in one thread. Spread them out, over the many weeks you're invited to participate. Make sure you post your shared tracks as a new base-level reply to the submission. This way we can see them.

You can record yourself as easily as using a cell phone and you can upload to myriad sites that allow music files. Lately, I've been trying Clyp.It.

Then, share...

What to expect: Someone will listen to your work. They may even comment to let you know their thoughts about your work. Chances are good that someone will appreciate your contribution, even if you're just banging on pots and pans.

We will get some drive-by trolling and carpet-shitting. Get over it. You can make fun of them, if you want. We do. We generally don't delete a damned thing, nor do we ban anyone. (Spam is so far the only exception to this.) You're on Voat, man up. They're harmless.

If they get too disruptive, one of us will ban them. So far, that has not happened. It could, it's just nobody has made anyone ban 'em yet. I'd like to keep it that way.

At the end of the day: Try to have a good time, without making someone else have a bad time. Share some music, and remember that it's you that makes this thread. Without you, this thread is just a few words and a starting point. Be the thread type that you want to be.
